title.sub: 在城市中自由切換形式
title.sub_en: Adapt to the City, Shift with Ease

works.description: 採無膠合模組化設計，靈活適應都市生活。可拆卸後跟讓鞋瞬間轉換為穆勒鞋，滿足不同場景。選用環保材質與穩固綁帶系統，兼顧機能、美學與永續理念。
works.longDescription:
採無膠模組化設計，透過可拆卸後跟實現包覆鞋到便鞋的流暢轉換。鞋面與鞋底以 Lock & Lace 系統串聯，無需黏合確保穩固連接，提升耐用與環保性。

設計語彙強調流暢輪廓與雕塑感，前傾剪影塑造俐落動感，雙針縫線創造自然摺痕，增強視覺包覆並突顯結構。無斷點消除鞋面與鞋底界線，呈現一體化的都市風格。
works.english: Urban Module features a glue-free modular design that adapts to urban life. The detachable heel transforms the shoe into a mule for different settings. Made with eco-friendly materials and a sturdy lacing system, it balances functionality, aesthetics, and sustainability.
works.english_detail:
Urban Module features a glue-free modular design, allowing a smooth transition from enclosed shoes to mules with a detachable heel. 

The Lock & Lace system secures the upper and sole without adhesives, enhancing durability and sustainability while emphasizing smooth contours and dynamic silhouette for an integrated urban style.

title.sub: 以花瓣作為靈感的椅子

works.description: 以花瓣般的結構為靈感，從中心向外延展並彎出拱形，以覆蓋與扣合的方式形成穩定結構。椅面以兩層帆布夾棉線，呈現水波紋的連續圖案，營造舒適輕鬆的室內氛圍。
works.longDescription:
以花瓣為靈感，透過弧形結構向下彎折，形成包覆且穩固的形態。表面以雙層帆布夾棉線縫製，創造水波般的連續紋理，強調視覺上的流動，也增添細膩的觸感體驗。

設計上兼具柔軟與結構，透過拼接覆蓋，使布料自然貼合形體，展現層次變化。整體造型宛如含苞待放的花朵，擁有輕盈且具包覆感的坐感，為空間帶來舒適的氛圍。
works.english: Inspired by petal structures, the design extends outward from the center, arching to form a stable structure through covering and fastening. The seat features two layers of canvas with cotton threads, creating a ripple pattern for a relaxed indoor atmosphere.
works.english_detail:
Inspired by petals, the design bends downward through an arched structure, forming a wrapped shape. 

The double-layered canvas with cotton stitching creates a ripple texture, adding visual flow and a tactile experience. The form resembles a blooming flower, offering light, enveloping seating, and comfort.
